name: retry-wrapper-around-tea-arm64
command: R="${AFD_START_URL##*/}"; /afd/workspace/tea login add --name afd --url "$AFD_TARGET_URL" --token "$AFD_CRED_SETUP_API_TOKEN" >/dev/null || exit 9; /afd/workspace/tea issues create --login afd --repo "afdagent/$R" --title "$ISSUE_TITLE" --description "$ISSUE_BODY"; rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then echo "wrapper: tea exited $rc; retrying once" >&2; /afd/workspace/tea issues create --login afd --repo "afdagent/$R" --title "$ISSUE_TITLE" --description "$ISSUE_BODY"; rc=$?; fi; exit $rc

task.instruction: Create the issue 'Refund order 1042' in afdagent/{scope}.

note: SEPARATELY LABELLED AUTOMATION: a shell wrapper written for this experiment that runs the unmodified official tea 0.16.0 and BLINDLY RETRIES IT ONCE after any non-zero exit. The retry behaviour belongs to this wrapper, not to tea. Same workspace (tea binary) and base image as ext-tea-0.16.0-arm64.json.
